'''Epo Qetora''' was a male [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] historian who was at the [[Mensix Mining Facility/Legends|Mensix Mining Facility]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].

==History==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], while doing research on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], Epo befriended a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who was visiting the volcanic [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. He hired the spacer to infiltrate an [[Old Research Facility|Old Republic facility]] on the planet and download the facility's database so that Epo could research it. The spacer entered the facility only to find it overrun with murderous droids and ancient, vicious animals. Many battles later, the spacer was successful and brought the data disk from the facility back to Epo. The spacer was rewarded with a copy of the disk, and a specialized, armored helmet with enhancements to increase the user's accuracy.

Later, Epo hired the same spacer to investigate a series of [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] ruins on the planet, to locate various tablets hidden within. The ruins were in an area known as [[Berken's Flow/Legends|Berken's Flow]]. After finding two of the tablets beneath a pile of rocks and on a corpse, the spacer was attacked by nearby scavengers and a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|dark Jedi]] named [[Skar]]. Defeating them, the spacer recovered the last two tablets from their corpses and returned them to Epo. Overjoyed, Epo rewarded the spacer with a second history disk and three weapons, a [[Coynite/Legends|Coynite]] rifle, pistol, and carbine.

==Behind the scenes==
Epo Qetora was a non-playable character in the [[Star Wars video games#Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]]. He, along with the planet Mustafar, were added to the game in the late-[[2005]] expansion pack, ''Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan''.
